messages:
Ava Martinez: Trying out the new next-lite-starter + LangChain wiring. Followed README, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, but intermittent 401s when calling the server API route from ISR pages. JS SDK doesn't seem to retry. Anyone seen this? cc @Ravi

Ravi Desai: Do you have a minimal repro? Is this a project key or ephemeral session token? JS SDK should only skip retry on 401.

Ava Martinez: Project key (long-lived). Minimal handler below — same used in starter:
```js
// pages/api/complete.js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference-js'
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const out = await client.chat({ model: 'redwood/alpha-mini', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: req.body.prompt }] })
  res.status(200).json(out)
}
```

Ava Martinez: Server logs show 401 sometimes then the edge function errors: 
```
2026-03-02T09:12:07Z WARN upstream 401 x-rw-error=invalid_api_key x-rw-exp=170
2026-03-02T09:12:07Z ERROR unhandled exception -> 500
```

Lina Gomez: Hmm, JS client used in starter caches the client instance for module scope. If platform rotates keys and returns x-rw-exp header, the client should detect expiry and refresh. I think the parity code landed in python client v0.4.0 but JS hasn't received it yet. Workaround: construct client per-request or check header and re-init.

Kai Park: I reproduced with a short-lived key simulation. The SDK stores the key on instantiation and ignores valid-until header for serverless lifecycles. Simple fix: on 401 with x-rw-exp present, invalidate cached key and retry once. I'll sketch a patch.

Ravi Desai: Good catch. Add an e2e case that simulates short-lived keys and asserts one retry on 401+rotation header. Also add a small Next.js smoke test that runs in CI.

CI Bot: workflow/devex-e2e.yml triggered by branch fix/sdk-auth-retry (run 1/1) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Kai Park: Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/812 — implements single retry when x-rw-exp <= now + 15s and re-creates internal auth cache. Includes unit + e2e sim.

Lina Gomez: Update the starter README with a note about serverless instantiation until SDK release and an inline example for getServerSideProps: create client inside handler to avoid stale keys.

Ava Martinez: Thanks — that matches my workaround. I'll re-run onboarding once PR merges.

Ravi Desai: I'll own adding the CI test and approving the PR after review. Assigning DEFECT-1122 to Kai+Ravi.

Ava Martinez: :thumbsup: saved a copy of repro in the starter repo under examples/auth-rotation.md

Lina Gomez: Follow-up: let's track telemetry for the starter so we can see if this was widespread. I enabled the flag for the sample app in staging.

Kai Park: CI green on the branch, merging once approval done.

Ava Martinez: Verified on staging after merge, ISR pages no longer surface 401s during key rotation. Closing my local repro. Thanks everyone!
